ينتهج (form VII)
# يَنْتَهِجُ (yantahiju) /jan.ta.hi.d͡ʒu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# يُنْتَهَجُ (yuntahaju) /jun.ta.ha.d͡ʒu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# يَنْتَهِجَ (yantahija) /jan.ta.hi.d͡ʒa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
